Not even all the human Sith Lords trace back to Vilia. But it is a big family.|Kerra Holt and Arkadia Calimondra|<ref name="Knight Errant (novel)">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Calimondra_family.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Members of the Calimondra family during a holo-conference]]
The '''Calimondra family''' was a family of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. [[Vilia Calimondra]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the matriarch of the family, acquired many husbands, expanding her empire. She mothered seven children, each of whom claimed the right to be Vilia's sole heir. In [[1066 BBY]], Vilia initiated the ''[[Charge Matrica]]'', a contest whose winner would be determined by which of Vilia's children could expand her empire the greatest. Vilia's empire expanded even farther; however, her children eventually went to war with one another. [[Chagras]] eventually defeated his rival siblings, but died suddenly in [[1040 BBY]]. Vilia was left with several grandchildren, each claiming right to her legacy. Vilia initiated a [[Second Charge Matrica|Second ''Charge Matrica'']], but, again, Vilia's potential heirs descended into war with each other.

On occasion, the members of the Calimondra would meet [[holograph]]ically during an event known as The [[Bequest]]. During The Bequest, Vilia would dole out rewards for her grandchildren's efforts. One such bequest took place in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Jutrand|liquidation]] of the [[Bactranate]] and the [[Battle of Byllura|annexation]] of the [[Dyarchy]].
